title: The exit monitor's registry-failure fallback covers 0 of 52 routed-live legs
note: MEASURED 2026-09-22 by parsing config/strategies.yaml (55 declared) + config/accounts.yaml (11 accounts) at 0d3ab95: 52 distinct strategies are routed to at least one `mode: live` account. src/runtime/pipeline.py:349-351 returns the hardcoded fallback ['turtle_soup','vwap'] whenever load_strategies() raises. NEITHER name is routed to any live account -- turtle_soup is `execution: shadow`, vwap is `enabled: false` + `execution: shadow`. The set difference is 52 of 52. [!] THIS IS NOT ONLY AN ENTRY-SIDE LIST. `STRATEGIES` is what the EXIT half iterates: run_exit_evaluation_tick calls _load_strategies(None) -> pipeline.STRATEGIES, then get_order_packages_by_strategy per name. On the fallback, every open package belonging to the other 52 legs receives NO monitor() call -- no trailing amend, no stale-exit, no giveback stop, no exit head. Open REAL-MONEY positions would sit unmanaged until a broker-side bracket or the reconciler caught them. [!] THE TRIGGER IS REACHABLE. STRATEGIES is a module-level constant evaluated once at import and the fallback fires on ANY load_strategies() exception -- a malformed config/strategies.yaml being the live one. ict-git-sync pulls main every ~5 min, so a YAML syntax error landing on main reaches the live trader inside ~5 minutes. [!] AND IT IS SILENT. One logger.warning at import. None of the health snapshot's 7 checks (service, git_drift, git_fetch, tick, accounts_api, db, disk) would go red -- the process is alive, ticking, in sync, and the DB answers. The snapshot keeps reading `7/7 checks ok`. [!] FIELD BEATS COMMENT: the comment at pipeline.py:350 asserts the fallback `matches the production roster in config/strategies.yaml after PR B1`. Measured today it matches 0 of 52 -- the same shape as the trainer flock comment fixed in de20550. [!] SECOND, SEPARATE COLLAPSE at order_monitor.py:124-126: _load_strategies returns [] on exception, and the tick then returns {} summaries -- `we could not resolve the strategy list` and `no strategy had anything open` are indistinguishable downstream. [!] PROPOSED FIX, not applied (Tier-2, and /health-review may not touch src/): (1) delete the VALUE fallback -- on registry failure raise, or return a sentinel callers must branch on; a trader that cannot read its own roster must not silently run a two-name one. (2) Make the exit half's population open-package-driven (SELECT DISTINCT strategy FROM order_packages WHERE status='open') UNION the roster, so an open position is monitored because it IS OPEN, never because it appears in a list. (3) Add a health check comparing len(STRATEGIES) against the enabled count in strategies.yaml. [!] REFUTED HYPOTHESIS, recorded so it is not re-derived: the TLT position open on alpaca_live (id 5924, pattern tlt_pullback_1h, opened 2026-09-18) belongs to a leg A6/#12673 pulled from the alpaca_live ROSTER on 2026-09-21, and is NOT stranded -- exit evaluation iterates the strategies.yaml registry, not account rosters, and tlt_pullback_1h is still enabled there (r-block updated 05:29Z). Roster removal does not strand an open position; registry FAILURE would strand all of them. [!] LANE session_014LSHstYGrXDTZnNW5kgjn8, 2026-09-22, branch `e21-exit-monitor-roster-resolution`. RE-MEASURED INDEPENDENTLY rather than inherited, by parsing config/strategies.yaml (55 declared) + config/accounts.yaml (11 accounts) at f3746ab: 52 distinct strategies routed to >=1 `mode: live` account; the fallback covered 0 of 52; turtle_soup `execution: shadow`, vwap `enabled: false` + `execution: shadow`. The review's numbers hold. That re-measurement is now a TEST (tests/test_e21_exit_roster_resolution.py::test_the_retired_fallback_covered_no_live_leg), so the comment cannot drift from the config again. [!] DECIDED (this lane, arguing the question the dispatch posed): THE ENTRY AND EXIT SIDES GET DIFFERENT ANSWERS, because the question 'fall back to a list, or refuse' is only hard while the exit half depends on that list. (1) ENTRY: no value fallback at all. `resolve_roster()` returns a three-state resolution (ok/empty/unreadable) and `STRATEGIES` is EMPTY on `unreadable`, so the trader opens nothing rather than opening the wrong two names. This is NOT the trader switching itself off (Prime Directive rule 2): no account `mode:` is written, no breaker latches, the process keeps ticking and comes up live on the next boot per YAML; it is a per-condition refusal with a logged cause, the same shape as `pipeline.strategy_builders()`, which is deliberately un-wrapped on the stated ground that 'a rollback that cannot resolve its roster must fail loudly rather than resolve to an empty dict and silently trade nothing'. And the old fallback was ALREADY a near-total entry halt -- 0 of 52 -- only a silent one that additionally re-enabled two deliberately non-executing legs. (2) EXIT: does not consult the roster state to decide what to monitor AT ALL. `order_monitor.exit_population()` is `SELECT DISTINCT strategy_name FROM order_packages WHERE status='open'` UNION the roster, in roster order. A position is monitored because it is OPEN. That is what makes (1) safe: refusing to open new positions no longer costs exit management of the open ones. [!] REQUIREMENT 3 (positions whose leg left the roster) IS ADDRESSED, AND THE ROW'S OWN REFUTED HYPOTHESIS IS CONFIRMED CORRECT rather than re-derived: exit evaluation never read ACCOUNT rosters, so A6/#12673 removing tlt_pullback_1h from alpaca_live's roster did not strand the open TLT position -- VERIFIED this session by reading src/strategy_registry.py::load_strategies, which does not filter on `enabled` or `execution` and returns all 55 declared names, and run_exit_evaluation_tick, which iterates that list. THE RESIDUAL GAP IS REGISTRY REMOVAL, NOT ROSTER REMOVAL: a leg deleted from strategies.yaml (or the whole file becoming unreadable) while holding an open position WAS stranded, and row R2 cuts four more legs. The union closes that, and is pinned end-to-end by test_exit_tick_scans_an_open_package_off_the_roster, which drives a real sqlite journal through run_exit_evaluation_tick. [!] REQUIREMENT 2 (not silent): new health check `strategy_roster` in src/runtime/health.py, added to _DEFAULT_CHECKS so the snapshot carries 8 rather than 7. `unreadable` and `empty` are BOTH critical and carry DIFFERENT ctx.state + detail -- the collapsed-state standard is that they must not render identically, not that they must grade differently. Registered as contract `strategy_roster.roster_state` in scripts/ci/check_collapsed_states.py; the guard reports `3 consumer(s), all states read`. The check re-reads the YAML through `strategy_registry.reload_strategies()` because the registry caches after first load -- without that bypass the check would answer from the last good read forever and could never fire, which is pinned by test_health_check_rereads_the_file_rather_than_a_cached_roster. [!] PROOF THE TESTS ARE A REGRESSION TEST AND NOT DECORATION: 11 tests, all passing on the branch. Re-run with src/ restored to f3746ab (the new module src/runtime/strategy_roster.py necessarily stays, since `git checkout <rev> -- src/` cannot remove a file that did not exist at that rev): 9 of 11 FAIL. Against a pristine f3746ab worktree the module errors at collection, i.e. 11 of 11. The 2 that pass in the hybrid run are the two config re-measurements, which are true of both revisions by construction. [!] STATUS, and the three words kept apart: MERGED - no (draft PR, held for the manager per the lane's dispatch). DEPLOYED - no. OBSERVED - no, and it CANNOT be yet: `STRATEGIES` is module-level and evaluated once at import, so nothing here reaches the live trader until ict-trader-live RESTARTS after the deploy; ict-git-sync pulls main every ~5 min. Filed as PI-20260922-NW5KGJN8-0001 with the two separate observations that would close it (a `strategy_roster` row in a vm-diag snapshot for the web-api half; a trader journalctl restart or the E21 off-roster warning for the exit half). This row must not go past `landed_unproven` on the merge alone. [!] CORRECTION, same session, before anyone acts on this row: an earlier draft of this note and of PR #12710 said ict-git-sync 'does not restart the trader'. That is WRONG and is withdrawn. VERIFIED by reading deploy/ict-git-sync.service (ExecStart=bash scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh) and scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh: the deploy DOES `systemctl restart ict-trader-live ict-telegram-bot ict-web-api`, gated on runtime_logs/deployed_sha.txt rather than on whether this fetch moved HEAD, and skips the restart only for a diff whose every path is non-runtime (docs/, tests/, .claude/, .github/, top-level *.md). This diff touches src/, so the restart fires and `deployed` follows `merged` within about one 5-minute tick. `observed` is still separate and still needs the two reads in PI-20260922-NW5KGJN8-0001. [!] MERGED 2026-09-22: PR #12710 squash-merged to main (the PR head 7d00831b0 is NOT an ancestor of main -- squash -- so verify by CONTENT, not by sha). VERIFIED on origin/main: src/runtime/strategy_roster.py present; `return ["turtle_soup", "vwap"]` occurs 0 times in src/runtime/pipeline.py; `def exit_population` present in src/runtime/order_monitor.py. STATE IS `landed_unproven`, NOT `done`, and the distinction is load-bearing: STRATEGIES is a module-level constant evaluated once at import, so the fix takes effect only when ict-trader-live restarts -- automatic within ~one 5-min git-sync tick, but a restart having been ISSUED is not the check appearing in a snapshot. THE OBSERVATION THAT CLOSES THIS ROW is PI-20260922-NW5KGJN8-0001's clears_when: a vm-diag snapshot carrying a `strategy_roster` health check with ctx.state=='ok' and ctx.resolved==ctx.declared (a snapshot showing 7 checks and no strategy_roster means the deploy has NOT landed), plus a trader journalctl restart later than the deploy commit for the exit half. [!] CI RESULT, recorded because it answers the one bullet this lane could not: on the merged head, `pytest-run`, `pytest-collect`, `Guards` and `repo-inventory` all PASSED. `merge-claim-audit` FAILED, and it is not this change's -- it checks out main and dies on an archived board-pointer.json, filed as PI-20260922-NW5KGJN8-0002. [!] THIS LANE GOT CI WRONG TWICE BEFORE FINDING THAT: it read `get_status`, which returns only legacy commit statuses (total_count 0) and cannot see Actions check runs, and reported 'no red CI'. A zero from a probe that cannot see the thing is not a zero.ANAGER 2026-09-22: MERGED as 9eb13192. NOT deployed, NOT observed -- which is why this is `landed_unproven` and not `done`. CLOSING THIS ROW MEANS observing a live tick calling monitor() on an open order package whose strategy_name is NOT in the roster. The standing worked example is already open: the real-money TLT position, pattern tlt_pullback_1h, opened 2026-09-18, on a leg A6 removed from alpaca_live's roster on 2026-09-21.
